name: lazy_drift_v1_vista
purpose: Attack C v1 smoke + perf probe: lazy drift mode (GIZMO_LAZY_DRIFT_ENABLE=1). move_particles iterates ActiveParticleList only; gpu_ngb_list_build's lazy-drift hook drifts neighbors before kernel use; compact_xyzh's h field inflated by GIZMO_LAZY_DRIFT_H_SLACK to absorb undrifted-neighbor h-staleness in BVH tile-overlap test. Pass criteria: no segfaults, mp_drift_time collapses from ~0.82s/step to ms-scale on tiny-N steps, total tiny-N wall drops from ~1.1s to ~0.3-0.5s. Compare against same-build run without GIZMO_LAZY_DRIFT_ENABLE for A/B physics-match.
